name: Nefra Obsidian Dawn
loreTies: Sacred order channels solar power into civilization.
Solar Law: coordinated Deities gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.
Nefra Obsidian Dawn is a colossal Aten Ra deity shaped by sacred order channels solar power into civilization. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Nefra Obsidian Dawn governs the border where the sun leaves the underworld and becomes visible again. Human funerary art copied fragments of her horizon masks and dawn reliefs. She controls terrain by deciding what may cross from shadow into light.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Nefra Obsidian Dawn began as more than a weapon in The Golden Dominion of Aten. Nefra Obsidian Dawn was bound to a solar pylon during a Gate disturbance that tested whether sacred order channels solar power into civilization could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Deity chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Aten Ra, Nefra Obsidian Dawn is treated as proof that a divine solar civilization of judgment, radiance, command, sacred order, temple law, and ancient solar mathematics can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms, but their real identity is tactical: defensive command, radiant control, judgment zones, solar sustain. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Nefra Obsidian Dawn; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Deity to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Nefra Obsidian Dawn survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever judgment zones appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Nefra Obsidian Dawn gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-deity Deity, Nefra Obsidian Dawn turns Solar Law from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Nefra Obsidian Dawn's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 36, attack 10, range 1, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Mesha and other Codex witnesses can interpret their Gate scar.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythicSource: Necropolis dawn + Duat horizon + obsidian judgement
visualCanon: Tall controller Deity of black sunrise: obsidian-blue enamel mask, thin amber dawn visor, horizon-ring collar, ivory limestone relief plates, black-gold scale armor, and angular light lanes emerging from underworld-shadow limbs. Must feel like living threshold law, not a mummy, statue, or necropolis building.
